assertion.statement: cert-manager 1.18.0 upgraded Pebble, the ACME test server used by its own end-to-end tests, to v2.7.0 and adjusted those tests to match the latest Pebble behavior; the change is confined to the test suite and has no operational consequence for cert-manager deployments.
